subject: Lumera — pause pilot during product release
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@lumera.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reprioritizing Q4 workstreams — Redwood demo

Hi Mina,

Quick update from our side after a leadership planning session this morning — we are moving up a product release that requires most of our engineering and data teams to focus on stability and documentation for the next two months. As a result, we're deprioritizing the LLM/inference pilot we had planned with Redwood for now.

Can we pause the demo and related kickoff activities until the release window cools down? We definitely want to keep this conversation alive — the use case still matters to us — but we won't have the bandwidth to run a pilot or attend technical walkthroughs until after the release.

My asks:
- Can you confirm receipt and pause scheduling?
- Could you share a one-page summary of the pilot configuration and any options for keeping a sandbox "warm" vs fully shutting down?
- We'll loop in procurement if we need any contract-level questions.

Attaching a short internal note (Lumera_Q4_plan.pdf) so you can see the timeline impact. I'll add procurement on the next email if we need pricing for a warm/suspended arrangement.

Thanks,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Product Operations
Lumera Inc.

Attachment: Lumera_Q4_plan.pdf (PDF, 150KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@lumera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Oct 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reprioritizing Q4 workstreams — Redwood demo

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the heads up and for sharing the Q4 note — appreciate the context. Completely understand the need to shift focus for an upcoming release. We'll pause active scheduling and freeze any internal demo prep on our side.

Quickly on the items you asked for:
- Confirmed: we can pause the demo and remove calendar invites for now.
- Summary: I'll send a one-page pilot recap (scope, sample dataset, expected infra footprint) by EOD.
- Warm vs Pause: two quick options below — happy to expand.
  * Keep sandbox warm: preserve a small sandbox with cached model weights and config; reduces restart time but carries a nominal monthly keep-alive cost.
  * Full pause: we archive the environment and only re-provision on re-engagement — no monthly cost but longer ramp-up.

If procurement will need numbers for a temporary arrangement, happy to include a simple pricing note. Would you prefer us to send that to you first or copy procurement on the next message?

Also: would you like a short standing check-in in mid-Jan to see where things land? We can keep it to 15 minutes.

I'll attach the one-page summary in a follow-up (and loop in Aditya for pricing).

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@lumera.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@lumera.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Oct 2028 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reprioritizing Q4 workstreams — Redwood demo

Thanks Mina — quick internal sync update: leadership would like us to fully prioritize the release. For planning, they want the pilot paused through the end of Q1 (so reopening in early April).

Procurement is cc'd — two asks for them:
1) If we elect to keep a small sandbox "warm", what is the estimated monthly cost and what exact resources are preserved?
2) If we do a full pause, are there any termination/archival steps we should be aware of, and what timeline should we expect for provisioning once we re-engage?

We also want to understand if there are any short-term discounted options for keeping the environment warm while we don't actively use it — leadership prefers a low-cost conservancy if that reduces restart friction.

Sofia Ramos
Head of Product Operations
Lumera Inc.

Attachment: SOW_draft_for_release_notes.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@lumera.com>, Procurement <procurement@lumera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Oct 2028 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reprioritizing Q4 workstreams — Redwood demo

Hi Sofia / Procurement team —

Appreciate the clarity and the timeline. Short answers below and then next steps.

Warm sandbox (recommended if you want fast restart):
- What we preserve: model cache (quantized weights), KV cache snapshot where feasible, configuration YAMLs, and a small reserved compute pool for quick spin-up.
- Estimated cost: $450/month to keep the environment warm in a minimal configuration (includes reserved disk, snapshot retention, and a modest reserved CPU/GPU allocation to avoid cold load). We can provide a breakdown if helpful.

Full pause (lower cost, longer ramp):
- What happens: we snapshot and archive the artifacts; no ongoing infra charge.
- Re-provision timeline: typical turnaround is 7–10 business days for reinstatement and validation, but depends on requested model variant and dataset updates.

Discounts: we can offer a 3-month reduced rate if you sign up for a warm-preservation plan now (details attached). If you'd like, Aditya and I can prepare a one-page pricing memo and a short SOW amendment for procurement.

Next steps:
- I'll attach a short pricing stub. (redwood-warm-keep-pricing.txt)
- Would you like to schedule a 15-min check-in Jan 15 to revisit? Here's a suggested calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=lumera-15min-checkin
- We'll mark the HubSpot deal RDW-2028-743 as "on hold - customer priority shift" and set a follow-up for 2029-04-01. HubSpot link: https://hubspot.company/deal/RDW-2028-743

Thanks — we'll make this as low-friction as possible and stand ready when the release stabilizes.

Best,
Mina Haddad
